name: Being Chosen
overview: Scripture reveals that being chosen by God is a divine act rooted in His sovereign will and purpose. From Israel being called a holy and peculiar people (Deuteronomy 14:2) to individuals like Jeremiah being ordained before birth (Jeremiah 1:5), God's choice is both corporate and personal. Christ affirms this in John 15:16, emphasizing that believers are chosen to bear lasting fruit through Him. While many are called, only a few are chosen (Matthew 22:14), underscoring the gracious and purposeful nature of God's election, which ultimately leads to eternal life for those who believe (John 3:16).
